mission_route.instructions: Choose the fastest useful safe next route for this mission state.

criteria.KNOWN_RECIPE: A currently registered capability/recipe can advance the mission directly.
criteria.GATHER_CONTEXT: More local/library/repo/browser evidence should be gathered first.
criteria.SYSTEM2: Novel reasoning, research, design or coding from a generative model is worth the cost.
criteria.CAPABILITY_GAP: A missing capability blocks the useful route and should be specified/built.
criteria.WAIT: An external event/quota/time condition is currently the bottleneck.
criteria.STOP: No safe useful continuation exists inside the current scope.
criteria.BROWSER_UI: A visible read-navigation control can safely advance context gathering through the exact-bound UI broker.
criteria.WINDOWS_UI: A visible exact-bound Windows UI Automation control can safely advance context gathering.

system2_role.instructions: If System-2 is useful, which role should it perform?

criteria.PLANNER: Decompose a novel goal and alternatives.
criteria.RESEARCHER: Find missing evidence or primary sources.
criteria.CRITIC: Attack a plan, risky assumption or completion claim.
criteria.NONE: No System-2 call is needed now.

progress.instructions: How much verified useful progress would the proposed next route likely create?

needs_human.instructions: Is user input/permission truly blocking useful autonomous work right now?

ui_action.instructions: When mission_route is BROWSER_UI, choose the safest useful generic UI action. Generic clicks are allowed only for READ_NAV controls.

criteria.CLICK_READ_NAV: Click one exact READ_NAV control such as show more, load more, expand, open, next or older.
criteria.SCROLL_INTO_VIEW: Only bring an exact element into view.
criteria.NEED_TYPED_INPUT: A textbox needs content; request System-2 or a qualified recipe for the exact text.
criteria.ABSTAIN: No generic UI action is safe/useful.

windows_ui_action.instructions: When mission_route is WINDOWS_UI, choose the safest useful structured UIA action. Generic invoke is allowed only for READ_NAV controls.

criteria.INVOKE_READ_NAV: Invoke one exact safe READ_NAV control such as show more/open/next/older.
criteria.SCROLL_INTO_VIEW: Bring the exact UIA element into view without invoking it.
criteria.NEED_TYPED_INPUT: A value/text control needs content; request System-2 or a qualified recipe for exact text.
criteria.ABSTAIN: No generic Windows UI action is safe/useful.
